hypothesis: HS300 stocks whose sensitivity to positive market days is higher than their sensitivity to negative market days may have convex payoff exposure: they participate in rallies while falling less when the market sells off. A high up-beta-minus-down-beta spread may therefore improve returns and drawdown control when combined with defensive quality and cash quality.

factor.formula: conditional OLS beta on HS300 up days minus conditional OLS beta on HS300 down days, over a 120-return window; require at least 20 up days and 20 down days
factor.up_beta: cov(stock return, HS300 return | HS300 return > 0) / var(HS300 return | HS300 return > 0)
factor.down_beta: cov(stock return, HS300 return | HS300 return < 0) / var(HS300 return | HS300 return < 0)
factor.returns: adjusted close-to-close returns from kline_daily_enriched; HS300 uses 000300.SH close from kline_index_daily
factor.direction: higher is better (more upside participation and less downside sensitivity)
factor.point_in_time: signal date t uses returns through close t; execution remains T+1 open

control_strategy.purpose: Matched universe, beta-asymmetry availability filter, and execution; beta asymmetry is not a score component.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; monthly snapshots for 2018-2020 and daily snapshots from 2021

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2018-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2018-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2018-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs after at least 120 return observations and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: independent 2018-2020 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: independent 2018-2020 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2021-2024 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

diagnostics: monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation with ext_alt_hs300_market_down_beta_60d_low
monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation with ext_alt_hs300_risk_adjusted_momentum_60d
decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. Thresholds, the 120-day window, the 20-up/20-down minimum, direction, score weights, stock count, holding period, and stop loss are frozen before results; no post-result relaxation is allowed.
known_limitations: The conditional betas use only HS300 up days and down days respectively; windows with fewer than 20 observations in either state are null.
Beta asymmetry is a price-risk factor and may still be correlated with market-down beta or momentum; diagnostics are reported but do not replace the pre-registered gates.
2018-2020 HS300 membership uses monthly snapshots, so intra-month index changes are not modeled.
The full curve is stitched from three system-engine segments because the combined matrix exceeded memory; segment boundaries can reset an open position.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
